nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What was the relationship between economic growth and environmental quality found in the study?
nodes.answer: Economic growth improves environmental quality, according to the findings of the study.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Decent work and economic growth|Economic stability|Economic growth_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How has the environmental goods sector performed compared to the overall economy in the European Union from 2000 to 2020?
nodes.answer: The environmental goods sector in the European Union has grown at an average annual growth rate of 3.4%, while the GDP grew by only 1.0% on average per year during that period.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Decent work and economic growth|Economic stability|Economic growth_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the traditional measure of economic growth often used by countries?
nodes.answer: The traditional measure of economic growth used by countries is gross domestic product (GDP).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Decent work and economic growth|Economic stability|Economic growth_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: According to the literature review, what are some negative effects of economic growth?
nodes.answer: Negative effects of economic growth include increased carbon emissions, global warming, and other forms of pollution.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Decent work and economic growth|Economic stability|Economic growth_qna_004
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How is economic activity represented in the studies referenced by Bennedsen et al. (2021)?
nodes.answer: Economic activity is represented by common factors extracted from a large set of annual macroeconomic US variables.
